name: Donchian channel-breakout new-high
rationale: Classic Donchian/Turtle channel breakout done as a long-lookback new-high proxy on daily bars: when the N-day return over a LONG window (20-80d) clears a high positive threshold, price is at/near a multi-week high (a channel breakout). An ADX floor confirms a real trend (Donchian whipsaws in chop, so we demand directional strength), and a Bollinger z-score ceiling keeps us from chasing an already-parabolic blow-off that is statistically overextended (late-entry/capacity guard). Long-only (spot). Disconfirmer: a stop-loss + take-profit close the trade if the breakout fails or stalls, so a false breakout is bounded.
catalyst: price prints a new multi-week high (long-lookback return breakout) in a confirmed uptrend
